chapter: Recent years and early piano influences
title: How he first heard of Art Tatum; cutting contests
summary: He tells of cutting contests, Percy's and Ruby's as hideouts where Tatum presided, and rumours about him.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Art Tatum: the legend, the piano and the man

blocks.x: I'm back in my teens again.
You've really not talked about Tatum much.
Who?
Tatum.
Oh, yeah...
They always said that Tatum was influenced by this Leif(?) Synge(?). Did you know of him?
Yeah. See, he had mentioned that to me; Art Tatum mentioned that to me. You must remember, first of all, how I know of Art Tatum -- if you want me to go into the story.
I want you to tell it in the greatest detail.

Well, there used to be... In those days they had cutting contests, you know. There was a lot of competition and a competitive thing with everybody, because there is no other way... When a new player was heard around, everybody wanted to see him, wanted to know him -- "Where is he? Where can we go?" And that's the way jam sessions were born. So that people gathered around... Tom Tillman was one...
Tom Tillman?
Tillman, yeah.
I never heard of him.
Oh yeah. Well, he was popular. All of the
Ramirez - 156

piano players were there. On certain days, you know, Mister Tatum presided. It was like everybody waited for him, you know. He was like the Chairman of the Board. And I cut many a class from high school, you know, waiting for Mister Tatum.
But anyway, there was a place called Percy's, and it was two flights up...
In Harlem.
In Harlem, yeah. And Tatum used to go there, and he would stay and drink his beer, and piano players congregated there. And there was another place called Ruby's.
Was Percy's a bar, or what was it?
It was a hideout.
Oh, I see.

Now, when Adelaide Hall came to the Lafayette from England and (?), they had two piano players. I think it was Joe Turner or Francis Carter, I don't know who it was... Because Joe at that time used to wear a derby hat, when he came from Europe... Boy, he was a natty...! I heard about this piano player. Everybody talked about this piano player that played... She had two pianos on the stage. I didn't see the (?). But they talked about him. "What's his name?" "Art Tatum." Well, I thought that was a funny name.
Ramirez - 157
I'd never heard of... "Tatum?" "Yeah."
